summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $15B+ SPX premium and extreme Call/Put ratios in META (0.18), AMD (0.26), and INTC (0.09). Significant directional conviction is visible in massive LEAPS, specifically the accumulation of SPX 7000C and 8000C strikes extending into 2031, alongside heavy $1B+ bets on SPX 8000P for 2026-2031, suggesting a massive "strangle" or volatility play on long-term index expansion. Persistent interest is concentrated in the SPX 200C and 1200C (exp 2026) and the 7000C (exp 2026/2031), totaling billions in multi-day accumulation. Traders should watch for continued strength in semiconductor and big tech (META, AMD, INTC) and monitor if the massive SPX 7000/8000 call premiums act as a magnet for the index or if the heavy 8000P accumulation signals an impending volatility spike.
